legacyApiBoundaries.floatAndVector: Instruction recognition is not semantic support. Baseline records explicit unsupported instructions for scalar FP and vectors; double signatures are rejected.
legacyApiBoundaries.stackArguments: Ten source arguments exceed the old public signature limit of eight; raw instruction recognition does not establish ABI reconstruction.
legacyApiBoundaries.indirectCall: Raw strict mode reports unresolved indirect call contract; a name alone is not a signature.
legacyApiBoundaries.entryState: Reconstructed C may add initial_sp and preserved-register parameters. fixture_direct output requires source arg plus initial_sp, initial_x19, initial_x20, initial_x29, initial_x30; callers must provide valid backing storage. An initial one-argument reconstruction harness was invalid and is not regression evidence.

notExercised: AL/AH/AX partial-write distinctions beyond EAX zero extension
PE delay/ordinal imports or forwarded exports
oracleStrategy: Offline test-only BigInt/IEEE-number reference functions check deterministic vectors. Trusted native C harness checks compiler output on compatible hosts. Current typed IR evaluator suites compare the same cases and memory side effects; service code never executes targets.
